channel.title: Paksh: Environment
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Indonesia Rescues Orangutans from Borneo Fires
item.description: Indonesian authorities have moved eight endangered orangutans to safety following fires in Borneo. The orangutans were rescued from the fires and released into a protected forest area. Communities in Indonesian Borneo are actively fighting… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Singapore Tops Air Pollution Rankings Amid Regional Haze
item.description: Singapore has again been ranked as the world's most polluted city, according to Swiss-based air quality monitor IQAir. The deterioration in air quality is attributed to toxic haze emitted from fires on Borneo and Sumatra islands… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ken-Betwa Project Floods Homes, Temples; Protests Erupt
item.description: Protests have erupted against the Ken-Betwa river-linking project following reports of flooded homes and submerged temples. Separately, floods in Nepal caused by a landslide blocking the Budhi Gandaki River have swept away homes and… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: PMK Leader Appeals to Save Palmyra Trees from Felling
item.description: PMK leader Sowmiya Anbumani has appealed to protect Palmyra trees from being felled. The appeal focuses on the preservation of these trees. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Oil Tanker Fire in Arabian Gulf; 22 Rescued
item.description: An oil tanker caught fire in the Arabian Gulf, leading to the rescue of 22 individuals by the UAE National Guard. The incident occurred in the Arabian Gulf. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Nepal Floods Destroy Homes and Bridges
item.description: Severe floods in Nepal have caused widespread destruction, with 35 houses and 10 bridges washed away. The floods, originating from the Budhi Gandaki River in Gorkha, have disrupted transportation and isolated large areas. Emergency… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Sikkim CM Advocates for Fish Species and River Conservation
item.description: Sikkim Chief Minister Prem Singh Tamang has emphasized the importance of conserving indigenous fish species and protecting aquatic biodiversity. He also stressed the need for river conservation efforts. The focus is on safeguarding the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: El Niño Linked to Extreme Weather Events Globally
item.description: El Niño has been linked to extreme weather events worldwide, including record rainfall in Tokyo and a desert bloom in Chile. Tokyo experienced 35 consecutive days of rain, its highest in centuries, attributed to El Niño. Additionally, a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Northern Lights Expected to be Visible Across UK and US
item.description: The Northern Lights are anticipated to be visible across the UK on Sunday night. Similar displays are also expected to return to 28 states in the US on Sunday, following previous epic displays. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Rain damages crops in Haryana and Punjab, farmers concerned
item.description: Heavy rainfall has impacted paddy and wheat crops in Gohana, Haryana, causing concern among farmers. In Fazilka, Punjab, rain has damaged grain markets, leading to an estimated loss of crores of rupees worth of paddy. Farmers in Haryana… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 3.

item.title: Yemen Faces Worsening Humanitarian Crisis Amidst Renewed Fighting
item.description: Yemen's humanitarian crisis is escalating, with over 184,000 people displaced since August due to renewed fighting between Houthi opposition forces and Government troops. Aid agencies report a growing hunger emergency, and mobile health… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Flash Flood Devastates Nepal, Sweeping Away Homes and Bridges
item.description: A flash flood triggered by heavy rain and a landslide in Nepal's Gorkha district has swept away over 35 houses and several bridges. The Budhi Gandaki River turned black and grey as the floodwaters inundated villages, leading to mass… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 18 · Right 4.

item.title: Mudslide sweeps cars and bus down street in Chile
item.description: A mudslide carrying floodwater surged down a street in Chile, sweeping away cars and a bus. The force of the muddy water created a pile of vehicles. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Telangana warns of power, water crisis due to El Niño
item.description: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy has warned of a potential power and water crisis in the state, attributing the threat to the impact of El Niño. Reports suggest the state may have failed to conserve water and secure adequate coal… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh Faces Heavy Rain, Thunderstorms, and Hail
item.description: Uttar Pradesh experienced a significant shift in weather on Tuesday, with several districts in the Terai and Purvanchal regions recording a drop in temperature due to thunderstorms, strong winds, and rain. In Lucknow, approximately 40,000… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 3.

item.title: Over 500 Trees to Be Removed at D.C. Golf Course for Redesign
item.description: More than 500 trees are slated for removal at a historic golf course in Washington D.C. to facilitate a redesign. The redesign is reportedly desired by President Donald Trump. The Park Service is overseeing the tree removal. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: 4.2 Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand
item.description: A 4.2-magnitude earthquake occurred in Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand, on Saturday night, causing panic among residents who rushed outdoors. This is the second tremor above magnitude 4 to hit Uttarakhand in four days. No damage has been reported. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: Powerful tornado strikes western Sicily
item.description: A powerful tornado has struck western Sicily, causing damage to buildings and cars in the towns of Marsala and Petrosino. Dramatic footage shows the tornado moving through the affected areas. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias batters US Southeast, causing power outages and two deaths
item.description: Hurricane Isaias made landfall in the US Southeast, battering Florida and Alabama with extreme winds and flash flooding. The storm left approximately 800,000 people without power. Two fatalities have been reported. Officials warned of… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 15 · Right 2.

item.title: Earthquake tremors felt in Uttarakhand's Uttarkashi region
item.description: Earthquake tremors were felt in the Uttarkashi district headquarters and the Yamunotri valley in Uttarakhand. The tremors registered a magnitude of 4.2 in Uttarkashi at 8:08 PM. Earlier, a 2.8 magnitude earthquake was felt in Bageshwar… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: El Nino reaches record strength, Japan agency reports
item.description: The El Nino weather phenomenon has reached its hottest recorded strength and continues to intensify, according to the Japan Meteorological Agency. The agency announced that El Nino is now at a record level and is still growing in strength. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Seychelles Giant Tortoises Outnumber Human Population
item.description: A recent survey in the Seychelles has found that giant tortoises now outnumber the human population. The reptiles were once near extinction but have since recovered. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Powerful 7.7 Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Panama, Damaging Buildings
item.description: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama, causing damage to buildings and triggering a tsunami warning for the eastern Pacific, which was later lifted. The earthquake was felt in Panama and neighboring Costa Rica. Videos of… Coverage: Left 7 · Centre 15 · Right 5.

item.title: Drought declared in Yorkshire due to low water levels
item.description: A drought has been declared in Yorkshire, England, due to critically low levels in reservoirs and rivers. The declaration comes amid concerns over water scarcity in the region. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: EU Nations Push to Delay Climate Science Reports Amid Fossil Fuel Lobbying
item.description: European Union nations are leading efforts to prevent fossil-fuel-producing countries from delaying the release of climate science reports. In parallel, one EU capital has voted to permanently ban fossil fuel advertisements. The coverage… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias Intensifies, Prompts State of Emergency in Florida
item.description: Tropical Storm Isaias has intensified and is forecast to become the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026. The National Hurricane Center (NHC) stated that Isaias is expected to strengthen rapidly and become a hurricane by Thursday. States of… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 16 · Right 2.

item.title: Somalia Faces Famine Risk Amidst Aid Cuts and Conflict
item.description: Somalia is facing a looming risk of famine due to funding cuts and ongoing conflict that is disrupting aid delivery to vulnerable populations. Reports indicate that the situation is dire, with limited resources like a small pot of rice… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India, China seek more time on climate science body reports amid deadlock
item.description: India and China are seeking additional time for the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) to finalize its reports, leading to a deadlock within the top climate science body. These assessments have been instrumental in shaping… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Panel to Inspect Aravalli Region for Conservation
item.description: A Supreme Court-appointed panel will inspect the Aravalli region in Rajasthan's Vagad, specifically Dungarpur and Banswara districts, starting October 11. The inspection is focused on conservation efforts related to mining and forest areas… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Communities Battle Fires in Indonesian Borneo
item.description: Residents in Indonesian Borneo are actively fighting against fires that are impacting their communities. The efforts involve local communities taking action to combat the blazes. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Climate Change Causes Loss of Largest Penguin Colony Title
item.description: A recent study has revealed that climate change has led to the loss of an island's title as home to the planet's largest penguin colony. The environmental shifts have impacted the colony's size, resulting in this change. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Mumbai heatwave: Santacruz records hottest October day in 8 years
item.description: Mumbai's Santacruz suburb recorded its hottest October day in eight years, with temperatures reaching 37.6°C. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) declared a heatwave for the city and issued yellow alerts for Maharashtra following the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Climate Change Impacts on Biodiversity Discussed
item.description: Coverage from The Economist and Deutsche Welle focuses on the effects of climate change, specifically its impact on biodiversity. The articles explore the relationship between changing climate patterns and the diversity of life on Earth. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Finland Halts Google Data Centers Over Environmental Concerns
item.description: Finland has ordered Google to halt construction on two data centers, citing environmental concerns. The decision, described as a pause, was made due to the potential impact on the environment. The locations are referred to as the 'Texas of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: India urges faster climate action and project delivery at Pre-COP31
item.description: India has called for accelerated climate action and the fulfillment of existing commitments at the Pre-COP31 meeting. The focus is on translating climate promises into tangible projects that directly benefit people. This emphasis on… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Concerns Rise Over Planned Data Centres in Scotland
item.description: Plans for at least 23 large data centres in Scotland have sparked significant concern among campaigners. The Economist's coverage explored the broader issues surrounding data centres, while BBC News focused on the specific situation in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Tropical System Brews in Gulf, Potential Hurricane Threat for U.S.
item.description: A tropical system is developing in the Gulf of Mexico and poses a potential hurricane threat to the United States over the weekend. Weather maps and path predictions are available for tracking the storm's development. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: 4.9 Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Uttarakhand, Tremors Felt in Delhi-NCR
item.description: A magnitude 4.9 earthquake struck Uttarakhand on Tuesday night, around 10:20 PM. Tremors from the earthquake were felt across parts of Delhi and the National Capital Region (NCR). Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Massive Hailstones Cause Widespread Damage in Paraguay's Capital
item.description: Paraguay's capital was struck by hailstones the size of tennis balls, resulting in widespread damage. The severe weather event caused significant destruction across the city. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: India's Monsoon Season Ends With Significant Rainfall Deficit
item.description: India's monsoon season concluded with a rainfall deficit of 12.6%, making it the fourth-lowest rainfall recorded since 2001. Fifteen states and Union Territories experienced below-normal rainfall during the season. The deficit was reported… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 8 · Right 4.
